page_title: GEN 1-1 ROM | Genoa v AS Roma 15/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+6' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Vitinha sends a long raking pass onto the head of Koni De Winter (Genoa), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the roof of the net. 1:1.
90+5' Confusion on the bench but it seems Daniele De Rossi has received a second yellow card from the ref and is walking off!
90+4' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+3' Vitinha (Genoa) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Mile Svilar is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90+1' The referee is firm and issues Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) a deserved yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
86' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jeff Ekhator (Genoa). Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
81' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) in, Artem Dovbyk out.
80' Here is a change. Milan Badelj is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Emil Bohinen (Genoa).
80' It will be a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Caleb Ekuban walks off.
79' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Mile Svilar.

78' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Antonio Giua with no other option than to blow for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
76' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
75' Manu Kone (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
70' Referee Antonio Giua halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Alberto Gilardino, then shows him a yellow.
70' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
67' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Mile Svilar.
66' Antonio Giua blows his whistle for a foul after Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) hacks down one of his opponents. Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' Antonio Giua shows the yellow card to Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) for a heavy challenge.
63' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
62' Substitution. Paulo Dybala will be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
62' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Stephan El Shaarawy is replaced by Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
62' That will be all from Niccolo Pisilli who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
61' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Milan Badelj (Genoa) takes it short.

60' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Mile Svilar is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play. Genoa win a corner kick.
59' Vitinha (Genoa) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post.
55' Referee Antonio Giua has finally had enough of Daniele De Rossi and brandishes a yellow card at him!

53' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the right side of the goal is saved by the excellent Pierluigi Gollini.
50' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch because Alexis Saelemaekers simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
49' Looks like Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
46' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) comes on the pitch for Morten Thorsby.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alessandro Vogliacco is replaced by Vitinha (Genoa).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is intercepted by Mile Svilar.
45+6' The free kick is taken by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but ball is cleared. It will be a corner kick for Genoa.
45+5' Angelino (AS Roma) jumps into a tackle and Antonio Giua signals a foul. That's a free kick to Genoa.
45+4' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+4' Manu Kone (AS Roma) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
45' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:1.
37' Referee Antonio Giua points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) goes wild in celebration.
37' Attention! Referee Antonio Giua straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
37' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
37' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
37' One of the Genoa players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. AS Roma have been awarded a free kick.
35' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

34' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
32' A pass into the box finds Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Pierluigi Gollini denies him.
31' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Antonio Giua who sees an offensive foul.
29' The ball rebounds out to Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
24' Manu Kone (AS Roma) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
20' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
19' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
16' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
15' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
14' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take a corner kick.
14' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. AS Roma win a corner.
13' Angelino (AS Roma) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
12' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Aaron Martin (Genoa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
5' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Genoa.
2' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Antonio Giua will officiate today.
